title: Terms of Service
intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") apply to the VAgeWell Care mobile app and website (the "App"), provided by VAgeWell ("we", "us", "our"). Please read them together with our Privacy Policy and Health Disclaimer.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of these Terms
paragraphs: By creating an account or using the App, you agree to these Terms, our Privacy Policy, and our Health Disclaimer. If you do not agree, do not use the App.
These Terms are an electronic record under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and do not need a physical or digital signature.

sections.heading: 2. Who can use the App
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You may add family members you care for, such as a parent, spouse, or child, as described in section 4.

sections.heading: 3. Your account
bullets: You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time password (OTP), or with Google. Keep your phone and OTPs private. You are responsible for all activity under your account.
Tell us immediately at info@vagewell.com if you suspect someone else is using your account.
Do not share your account or create an account in another person's name.

sections.heading: 4. Family members
paragraphs: You may add family members and book care or use the App's tools for them. By adding someone, you confirm that you have their permission, or that you are their parent or legal guardian if they are a child or cannot decide for themselves. You are responsible for the information you enter about them.

sections.heading: 5. What the App provides
paragraphs: The App lets you book home care services and use wellness tools in four areas:
numbered: Nutrition: BMI and body measurements, Meal Scanner, health self-assessments, and diet guidance.
Exercise: mobility training, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise services.
Bio Markers: vital monitoring (such as blood pressure, sugar, and oxygen), Lab Report Insights, and health records noted by our care staff.
Mind & Wellbeing: wellbeing and psychological support, spiritual care, and relaxation care.
after: We may add, change, suspend, or remove features at any time. Features marked "Coming soon" or "Beta" may be incomplete.

sections.heading: 6. Not medical advice
bullets: The App's tools are for general wellness. The App is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Scores, AI estimates, and suggestions in the App are for information only. They do not replace advice from a qualified doctor, dietitian, physiotherapist, or mental health professional.
Always consult a qualified professional before changing your diet, exercise, medicines, or supplements. Never ignore or delay professional advice because of something in the App.
The App is not for emergencies. In a medical emergency, call 108 (ambulance) or 112, or go to the nearest hospital. For mental health support, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24×7).

sections.heading: 7. Bookings, care visits, and fees
bullets: The App is free to download and use.

Home care services booked through the App are paid. Our team will confirm the date and time with you and tell you the charges, usually after the visit. You pay our care staff directly. We will always tell you the charges before you pay.
Care visits are delivered by our care staff or partner professionals. Your treating doctor remains responsible for your diagnosis and treatment.
Please give us as much notice as possible if you need to cancel or reschedule a visit.

sections.heading: 8. Third parties
paragraphs: The App may refer you to labs, meal providers, or other independent providers. They are responsible for their own services, and their own terms apply. Links to third-party websites or services are provided for convenience only.

Upload unlawful, offensive, or harmful content, or content that infringes anyone's rights.
Copy, modify, reverse engineer, scrape, or resell any part of the App.
Interfere with the App's security or operation, or try to access other users' data.

paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of India. We will first try to resolve any dispute informally, so please contact us at info@vagewell.com. Disputes we cannot resolve are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, India.

sections.heading: 18. Grievances and contact
paragraphs: For complaints about the App or its content, contact our Grievance Officer, Mr. Selva, at info@vagewell.com or +91 93427 03376. We will acknowledge your complaint within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 15 days.
